assumption: Allocates unique, monotonically increasing SlotIdx. No slot reuse or reclamation.
risk_if_false: Slot reuse could cause condition/body slot collision at runtime.
mitigation: Recorded in PO-KANI-006 slot uniqueness harness.

assumption: Appends node with correct step index. Node positions match their StepIdx values.
risk_if_false: Node ordering mismatch could cause execution graph corruption.
mitigation: Recorded in PO-KANI-012 emission parity harness.

assumption: Resolves integer-like strings to SlotIdx values in range [0, u16::MAX). Returns Err for non-integer strings.
risk_if_false: Invalid slot resolution could cause slot access violations.

assumption: Assembles ChooseSlot node correctly from SlotBranch entries. Enforces fanout limit.
risk_if_false: Malformed ChooseSlot node could cause replay dispatch errors.
mitigation: Defense-in-depth with fanout check at both call sites.

assumption: Correctly rejects empty branch table without otherwise.
risk_if_false: Empty branch table could cause runtime deadlock.

assumption: Precomputes step widths correctly using canonical_step_width dispatch (which now calls fixed choose_width).
risk_if_false: Layout mismatch could cause step index corruption.
mitigation: choose_width now computes correct width; PO-KANI-012 verifies parity.

assumption: Maps step names to StepIdx correctly, including generated nodes.
risk_if_false: Otherwise label resolution could map to wrong step.
mitigation: Existing tests verify otherwise resolution correctness.

assumption: Uses checked_add and canonical_body_step_width. No overflow, no panic.
risk_if_false: Width computation errors could cascade to layout mismatch.

assumption: Converts usize → u16 → StepIdx, rejecting values > u16::MAX.
risk_if_false: StepIdx values > u16::MAX could cause node ID corruption.

assumption: Bounds-checked StepIdx advancement. Returns Err on overflow.
risk_if_false: StepIdx arithmetic overflow could cause node ID collisions.
mitigation: Used throughout body lowering; PO-KANI-005 verifies.

assumption: Constructs SetConst node with correct id, output slot, value, and next pointer.
risk_if_false: Malformed SetConst could cause incorrect slot writes.
mitigation: Used by emit_choose_branch_body; existing tests cover SetConst.

assumption: Correctly rejects invalid IR (graph, nodes, reachability, slots).
risk_if_false: Invalid IR could pass validation and cause runtime errors.
mitigation: Existing validation tests cover many error cases.

assumption: Produces valid ChooseBranch AST with correct when and steps fields.
risk_if_false: Malformed AST could cause lowering to produce invalid IR.
mitigation: YAML parser has its own test suite.

assumption: Dispatches to correct per-branch target at runtime. Uses SlotBranch.target.
risk_if_false: Wrong dispatch could cause execution to jump to wrong node.
mitigation: PO-KANI-009 and PO-KANI-010 verify replay properties.

assumption: Returns Ok(1) for Set/Do, Err for other primitives. Width computation is correct.
risk_if_false: Wrong body step width could cause layout/emission mismatch.
mitigation: Used by choose_width via body_width; PO-KANI-001 verifies.

description: Kani harness unwind bounds are sufficient for the domain. Body step count ≤ 5, branch count ≤ 64.
justification: Bounded model checking requires finite unwinding. The chosen bounds cover the fanout limit and typical body sizes.
risk: Counterexamples beyond the unwind bounds would not be detected.

description: Canonical body steps are only Set and Do primitives. Other primitives (ForEach, Choose, etc.) are rejected by canonical_body_step_width.
justification: The canonical pathway restricts body steps to Set/Do. This is enforced by the production code returning Err for unsupported primitives.

description: SlotBranch.condition is typed as SlotIdx, not String. The type system prevents YAML strings from leaking into IR.
justification: This is a type-system property of the production code. The harness verifies non-vacuity by checking that slot_from_text is called for every when field.

description: Verus spec fn is_boolean_slot is simplified (returns true). Full model requires tracking map of slot → type.
justification: The full slot type tracking is not yet in the production type system (waiver WVR-001). The simplified model captures the intended invariant.

description: Boolean slot type check is a runtime guard, not a compile-time proof. Slot types are determined by construction (Set steps create typed slots).
compensating: Runtime type check in replay_choose_slot returns Internal error for non-Bool condition values (PO-KANI-009).

description: Flux refinement annotations require nightly Rust and the cargo-flux toolchain. Runtime tests in the same file provide fallback evidence.
compensating: Runtime tests verify slot count property at execution time.

description: Kani harnesses use concrete strings for StepAst construction (not kani::any() for Strings). String Arbitrary is not implemented for Kani.
justification: Kani does not support symbolic strings. The harnesses use concrete string values while varying numeric inputs symbolically.

description: choose_width harnesses use 'wrapping_add' for expected width computation, not 'checked_add'. This avoids overflow in the harness while the production code uses checked_add.
justification: The harness generates inputs within safe bounds (≤ 16 branches × ≤ 5 steps = 80 max nodes). wrapping_add is safe in this range.
